entries.title: Fixed Lattice Mast and Balanced Truss Tower Crane
entries.description: One newly authored whole fixed tower-crane illustration. An upper platform and fixed broad slewing-style drum carry a separate head, one long triangular-section three-web main jib and an opposite shorter open counter-jib with one whole counterweight exterior. A complete open A-pylon and two fixed ties link the unequal arms; one separately supported window-open side cab and a fixed under-jib trolley, continuous suspension and complete empty open hook finish the whole. No old column I-beam, tripod, timber walking drum, cabin or hook mesh is extracted or rearranged. Main-jib triangular section, two unequal arms and open four-sided lattice tower are real geometry, not a scaled old single-column cantilever. Four opaque constant PBR materials, metres, native Z up, actual whole horizontal bounds-centred grounded origin. One prop zero scenes.
